descriptions.warehouses: Your workspace owns every warehouse below it, who may enter them, and who may administer the workspace itself.
descriptions.workspaceRoles: Workspace roles decide who may administer this workspace. They never grant anything inside a warehouse.
descriptions.members: Workspace members administer the workspace. Everyone else here belongs to a warehouse but holds no workspace role.
descriptions.permissions: The workspace permission catalogue. Every permission here decides a workspace capability and never grants anything inside a warehouse.

nameWorkspace.title: Name your workspace
nameWorkspace.description: A workspace is created without a name. Naming it replaces the placeholder everyone currently sees.
nameWorkspace.descriptionRename: The new name replaces the current one for everyone in this workspace.
nameWorkspace.nameDescription: 1–100 characters. Control characters are rejected; names need not be unique.

authorityLost.title: Your workspace authority changed
authorityLost.description: Your workspace role changed while this page was open. The controls you may still use have been refreshed.
